svg.aria-label: Public PC threat model with keylogger and AI-personalized phishing bypassing SMS OTP, layered defense using TOTP app and YubiKey hardware token with origin binding, passkey FIDO2 WebAuthn eliminates shared-secret model via domain-bound biometric authentication synced across providers and phishing-resistant by design.
